description: Merge a duplicate tag (page) INTO another one: all its links (contacts, entries, tasks, notes, companies) move to the target without duplicates, every #source# / [[source]] in content is rewritten as the target's name, then the source tag is deleted. Use it when two pages describe the same project or theme (e.g. 'Livre' and 'livre photo'), or when update_tag refuses a rename because the name already exists. Confirm with your user which page to keep.

source_id.description: UUID of the tag to merge away (it will be deleted)

target_id.description: UUID of the tag to keep

name: merge_tag
